item.title: Playing Assassin's Creed Odyssee on an (Android) Handheld feels magical
item.author: invalid@example.com (mavericktopgun)
item.dc:creator: mavericktopgun
item.content:encoded: So there is a kinda new Android app called Droid Deck and it's essentially SteamOS in an app. I tried some games today and also Assassin's Creed Odyssee... Wow. Just look at it Runs with 30+ fps (I capped it at 30), 720p, low/medium/high graphic settings and looks just beautiful on my Odin 3 Max with its OLED Display. Loading times are kinda long with this game but I hope it gets better over time.
